notes.title: Important game update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this game has undergone many major updates, the update is as follows:

F key to complete the puzzle quickly
Esc setting interface can adjust touch range R, touch intensity S, touch elasticity E
Modify some features

This update will bring you a better gaming experience and wish you a happy game!

notes.title: Game Update
notes.content: Hello, everyone, This update adds 5 excellent pictures, Further optimized the game, The creative workshop has entered the preparation stage, and we believe that we will meet you soon, I wish you a happy game !

notes.title: Achievement system is online
notes.content: Hello everyone, This update adds an achievement system, Need to meet the corresponding conditions to get achievements, Can better experience the fun of steam games, We will also explore more features, including the use of creative workshops, and we will update the game as we make new progress, I wish you a happy game !

notes.title: Questions about Pictures
notes.content: Hello,everyone, Recently we received some feedback and hope that we can have original images, We need to explain the situation, We do this game in the hope that you can get more fun from your favorite pictures, which is equivalent to a tool, So the game is called《Happy toys》, We cite the picture in the hope of showing the《Happy toys》function while driving those excellent artists, Each picture has an ID, you can find the artist and see their other works, Having more pictures can make you happier, and the painter hopes that his works can be found by more people, We want everyone to be happy, So the game is called 《Happy toys》, You can leave a message here if you have any comments, We will see that, Wish you a pleasant game !

notes.title: The game is officially on sale
notes.content: 《Happy toys》is now officially on sale, Your favorite pictures come in handy !

notes.title: 1.2 Version Update
notes.content:
1.2 Version Update Content:

1. Enhanced ability to calculate background color, Better calculate the background color that matches the color of the picture
2. Optimized the game
3. Add 5 new excellent pictures

December 14 is coming soon, Let us witness this wonderful game together, Thank you for your attention !
